Prove that 11n+3 is odd provided that n is an even integer.

Let n be an even integer. Then, n=
2a
2a+1
2a
2a−1
for some integer a.

Therefore,
 
2(11a+1)
2(11a+4)
2(11a+2)
2(11a+1)+1
2(11a+4)+1
2(11a+2)+1
11n+3={(2(11a+1))(S1)}.
